name: Level_1 - Task_9
description: Prepare the main 800 K copper dataset for the later regression study. Use the supplied periodic 32-atom copper cell and MACE-MP-0 teacher. Initialize velocities at 800 K with a recorded random seed, remove center-of-mass momentum, and keep the cell fixed. Choose suitable integration, thermostat, equilibration, production, and sampling settings. Continue directly from equilibration into production without replacing atoms or reinitializing velocities. Retain 200 chronological production frames with their times, cells, positions, momenta, energies, and forces. Use the energy series to estimate its temporal correlation and report a characteristic correlation time or a supported bound. Save the boundary state, raw log, thermal trace, correlation data, settings, and scripts needed to check the run and analysis.
submission_format: Submit the path to your completed manifest.json file. Use the blank example as a guide and fill in only the parts needed for this task. Leave the Level 2 parts empty. Paths inside the manifest may be relative to the manifest file.
